nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable contract, set to msg.sender in the constructor and mutated by renounceOwnership/_transferOwnership.
Boolean pause flag initialized to false; written by pause() and unpause(), read by pause modifiers.
Mapping from role name string to Roles.Role storage struct holding bearer addresses.
Token balance mapping address => uint256, updated by transfer, transferFrom and _burn.
Total token supply storage variable, reduced by _burn and initialized by the BlockFollowToken constructor.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => uint256, updated by transferFrom, approve, increaseApproval and decreaseApproval.
Constant role name string 'administrator' used for the RBAC role of paused-time administrators.
Token name string set in the DetailedERC20 constructor.
Token symbol string set in the DetailedERC20 constructor.
Token decimals value set in the DetailedERC20 constructor and used for initial supply scaling.
Ownable constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that emits OwnershipRenounced and sets owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function that delegates ownership transfer to _transferOwnership.
Internal function validating the new owner and writing owner state.
onlyOwner / whenNotPaused function setting paused = true.
onlyOwner / whenPaused function setting paused = false.
Library function granting a role to an address (role.bearer[addr] = true).
Library function revoking a role from an address (role.bearer[addr] = false).
Library function requiring that an address holds a role.
Library view function returning whether an address holds a role.
Public view function reverting when addr lacks roleName.
Public view function returning role membership for addr/roleName.
Internal function adding a role to an address and emitting RoleAdded.
Internal function removing a role from an address and emitting RoleRemoved.
Library multiplication with zero short-circuit and overflow assertion.
Library integer division, truncating the quotient.
Library subtraction asserting b <= a before subtracting.
Library addition asserting c >= a to detect overflow.
ERC20 transfer updating sender and recipient balances with SafeMath and emitting Transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom updating balances and allowance with SafeMath.
Increases an allowance using SafeMath.add and emits Approval.
Decreases an allowance, zeroing it when the subtracted value exceeds the current allowance.
onlyOwner function granting ROLE_ADMINISTRATOR to an address.
onlyOwner function revoking ROLE_ADMINISTRATOR from an address.
Pausable transfer gated by whenNotPausedOrAuthorized, delegating to super.transfer.
Pausable transferFrom gated by whenNotPausedOrAuthorized, delegating to super.transferFrom.
Public burn entry point calling _burn with msg.sender.
Internal burn reducing balances[_who] and totalSupply_ and emitting Burn/Transfer.
Constructor setting name, symbol and decimals metadata.
Final token constructor setting metadata, computing initialTotalSupply and minting to msg.sender.
Externally controlled caller address used for owner assignment, balance/allowance indexing and access control checks.
Addition c = a + b followed by an overflow assertion inside SafeMath.add.
Subtraction a - b guarded by assert(b <= a) inside SafeMath.sub.
Multiplication c = a * b with zero short-circuit and overflow assertion inside SafeMath.mul.
Paired balance state writes (sender subtraction, recipient addition) in BasicToken.transfer.
Reduction of totalSupply_ by the burned value in BurnableToken._burn.
Initial supply multiplication 210e6 * (10 ** decimals) performed without SafeMath in the BlockFollowToken constructor.
Parameter 'roleName' of the RBAC onlyRole modifier.
Local variable 'c' holding the multiplication result in SafeMath.mul.
Local variable 'c' holding the addition result in SafeMath.add.
Local variable 'oldValue' caching allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in decreaseApproval.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
Ownable.constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before renounceOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
pause() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
unpause() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
onlyRole modifier passes msg.sender as the addr argument of checkRole.
hasRole(msg.sender, role) is used for caller role membership checks.
addAdministrator is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
removeAdministrator is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
BasicToken.transfer indexes balances with msg.sender as the sender account.
msg.sender is used as the key into the balances mapping in transfer and burn paths.
msg.sender is used as the owner key in the nested allowed allowance mapping.
BurnableToken.burn forwards msg.sender as the _who argument to _burn.
whenNotPausedOrAuthorized calls hasRole(msg.sender, ROLE_ADMINISTRATOR) to gate transfers.
whenNotPausedOrAuthorized calls hasRole(msg.sender, ROLE_ADMINISTRATOR) to gate transferFrom.
renounceOwnership sets owner = address(0).
transferOwnership delegates to the internal _transferOwnership function.
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into the owner state variable.
_transferOwnership validates and consumes the _newOwner parameter.
pause() sets paused = true.
unpause() sets paused = false.
RBAC.checkRole delegates to the Roles.check library function.
RBAC.hasRole delegates to the Roles.has library function.
RBAC.addRole delegates to the Roles.add library function.
RBAC.removeRole delegates to the Roles.remove library function.
Roles.check requires has(role, addr) to be true.
Roles.add writes role.bearer[addr] = true inside the RBAC roles mapping.
Roles.remove writes role.bearer[addr] = false inside the RBAC roles mapping.
Roles.has reads role.bearer[addr] from the RBAC roles mapping.
BasicToken.transfer updates sender and recipient entries of the balances mapping.
BasicToken.transfer subtracts _value from the sender balance via SafeMath.sub.
BasicToken.transfer adds _value to the recipient balance via SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.transferFrom updates balances[_from] and balances[_to].
StandardToken.transferFrom decrements the allowed[_from][msg.sender] allowance.
StandardToken.transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance decrements.
StandardToken.transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance increment.
StandardToken.approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
StandardToken.allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
StandardToken.increaseApproval updates allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
StandardToken.increaseApproval uses SafeMath.add on the existing allowance.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval rewrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
StandardToken.decreaseApproval uses SafeMath.sub on the existing allowance.
BurnableToken.burn delegates to the internal _burn function.
_burn reduces balances[_who] by the burned value.
_burn reduces totalSupply_ with SafeMath.sub; supply accounting depends on subtraction safety.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for both the balance and the total supply reduction.
BasicToken.balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
BasicToken.totalSupply returns totalSupply_.
addAdministrator calls isAdministrator to avoid duplicate role assignment.
addAdministrator calls RBAC.addRole with ROLE_ADMINISTRATOR.
removeAdministrator calls isAdministrator before revoking the role.
removeAdministrator calls RBAC.removeRole.
isAdministrator delegates to RBAC.hasRole.
PausableToken.transfer delegates to super.transfer in BasicToken.
PausableToken.transferFrom delegates to super.transferFrom in StandardToken.
DetailedERC20 constructor assigns the name metadata variable.
DetailedERC20 constructor assigns the symbol metadata variable.
DetailedERC20 constructor assigns the decimals metadata variable.
BlockFollowToken constructor invokes the DetailedERC20 constructor.
Constructor computes initialTotalSupply = 210e6 * (10 ** decimals) without SafeMath.
Constructor initializes totalSupply_ with initialTotalSupply.
Constructor mints the whole initial supply into balances[msg.sender].
Constructor credits the entire initial supply to the untrusted deployer address msg.sender.
SafeMath.add performs the unchecked addition followed by the c >= a assertion.
SafeMath.sub performs the subtraction guarded by assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul performs the multiplication with an overflow assertion.
BasicToken.transfer performs the paired balances state writes.
_burn writes totalSupply_ = totalSupply_.sub(_value), a supply-decreasing arithmetic state change.
decreaseApproval performs conditional allowance subtraction or zeroing.
Constructor performs the unscaled multiplication for the initial token supply.

The _subtractedValue parameter flows into the allowance arithmetic.

_newOwner is forwarded from transferOwnership into _transferOwnership.

PausableToken.transfer forwards _value to BasicToken.transfer.
